targets.rawSql:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    CASE '$report_period'
      WHEN 'today'      THEN date_trunc('day', now())
      WHEN 'this_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now())
      WHEN 'this_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now())
      WHEN 'last_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now()) - INTERVAL '7 days'
      WHEN 'last_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now()) - INTERVAL '1 month'
    END AS range_start,
    CASE '$report_period'
      WHEN 'today'      THEN date_trunc('day', now()) + INTERVAL '1 day'
      WHEN 'this_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now()) + INTERVAL '7 days'
      WHEN 'this_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now()) + INTERVAL '1 month'
      WHEN 'last_week'  THEN date_trunc('week', now())
      WHEN 'last_month' THEN date_trunc('month', now())
    END AS range_end,
    CASE '$report_period'
      WHEN 'today' THEN INTERVAL '1 hour'
      ELSE INTERVAL '1 day'
    END AS bucket_width
)
SELECT
  time_bucket(p.bucket_width, r.time) AS time,
  m.description,
  MAX(r.total_kwh) - MIN(r.total_kwh) AS value
FROM accumulator_electricity r
JOIN meters m USING (meter_id)
CROSS JOIN params p
WHERE r.time >= p.range_start
  AND r.time < p.range_end
  AND m.is_main = FALSE
  AND m.meter_type = 'electricity'
  AND m.zone IN ($zone)
GROUP BY time_bucket(p.bucket_width, r.time), m.meter_id, m.description, p.bucket_width
ORDER BY time ASC;
